data.why: The app takes a miRNA sequence typed into a text box (no file upload); the README/UI already shows an example sequence (let-7a: UGAGGUAGUAGGUUGUAUAGUU), so no uploadable test files are needed. config.py was overwritten (seed) to bind 127.0.0.1:8000 instead of the repo default 0.0.0.0:4242.

goals: Paste a miRNA sequence and get a set of forward and reverse qPCR primer candidates designed by the published algorithm
Check each candidate primer's melting temperature (Tm) and length to pick ones compatible with a standard qPCR cycling protocol
Check the 3' end A/T-content status flags (last 2, 3, and 5 bases) to avoid primers prone to mispriming
Try an out-of-range or invalid sequence (too short, too long, or containing non-RNA letters) to see how the tool reports the error
Compare primers generated for different miRNAs (e.g. let-7a vs. another miRNA) to see how primer count and quality vary with sequence composition

review.summary: The tree shows this one-form miRNA qPCR primer designer well, and every screen I opened (12) matches what its node says. It needs small wording fixes before filing: the cited article's year, the 16–39 nt length range, and one wrong task link in f2. It would also help to note that the Tm check passes by design and to cover choosing a forward/reverse pair.
